title: Monotonicity of the Bobkov functional under noise
statement: Let $f:\{0,1\}^n\to\mathbb R$ take values in $[0,1]$. The map $\rho\mapsto B(T_\rho f)$ is nondecreasing on $[0,1]$; that is, whenever $0\le\rho_1\le\rho_2\le1$, one has $B(T_{\rho_1}f)\le B(T_{\rho_2}f)$.
hypotheses_covered: A Boolean function on the n-dimensional Boolean cube
replaced: For a real function $f$ on the uniform Boolean cube $\{0,1\}^n$, write $D_i f(x)=(f(x^{i\leftarrow0})-f(x^{i\leftarrow1}))/2$ and $B(f)=\mathbb E\sqrt{\overline I(f)^2+\sum_i(D_i f)^2}$, where $\overline I$ is the Gaussian profile extended by zero outside $(0,1)$. For $f:\{0,1\}^n\to[0,1]$, the map $\rho\mapsto B(T_\rho f)$ is increasing on $[0,1]$, where $T_\rho$ is Boolean noise with correlation $\rho$.
